title: Career hub cities in Asia with Ledger, part 7
summary: Part 7 of the career cities series covers 9 career hubs in Southeast Asia, one sourced fact each; revised 18 Nov 2026 for Hoang's change request; paper and flat versions with the same voice
changesFromV2: Hoang, 18 Nov 2026: "Singapore should be wealth managemnet and video game, move it to first and then BAc Ninh, add in Ho Chi Minh City as well"

Singapore is now stop 1 with two industries in two fact beats on the same city scene: wealth management (S$6.7 trillion assets under management, MAS, end of 2025; OCBC, Bank of Singapore and UOB logos) and video games (Sea: over 100 million Garena players a day in 2025; Sea, Ubisoft and Virtuos logos)
Bac Ninh is stop 2 (was 1); Ho Chi Minh City is new as stop 3 (business and finance: about 23 percent of Vietnam GDP in 2025; Vinamilk, Masan and ACB logos)
The other stops keep their order: Phnom Penh, Bangkok, Rayong, Penang, Morowali, Manila; nine stops instead of eight
Summary line shortened to So that was Southeast Asia, to stay under 2:00 (112.0 s); the voice was not sped up
Same voice and settings as before (ElevenLabs gPiEpcKoaZywgOzc0Zn9, tempo 1.12, speed 1.08); the flat copy reuses the paper voice

beats.label: title
beats.voice: Career hub cities in Asia with Ledger, part seven.

beats.label: stop 1 Singapore
beats.voice: First, Ledger lands in Singapore, a hub for wealth management and video games.

beats.label: stop 1 Singapore
beats.voice: Asset managers here oversaw 6.7 trillion Singapore dollars in 2025.

beats.label: stop 1 Singapore
beats.voice: Sea, based here, drew over 100 million Garena players a day.

beats.label: stop 2 Bac Ninh
beats.voice: Then, he flies to Bac Ninh, Vietnam, a hub for phones.

beats.label: stop 2 Bac Ninh
beats.voice: Samsung's plants here and nearby have made 2 billion phones.

beats.label: stop 3 Ho Chi Minh City
beats.voice: Next, he flies to Ho Chi Minh City, a hub for business and finance.

beats.label: stop 3 Ho Chi Minh City
beats.voice: The city made about 23 percent of Vietnam's GDP in 2025.

beats.label: stop 4 Phnom Penh
beats.voice: Then, he hops to Phnom Penh, Cambodia, a hub for garments.

beats.label: stop 4 Phnom Penh
beats.voice: Cambodia's garment, shoe and travel goods factories employ over 900,000 people.

beats.label: stop 5 Bangkok
beats.voice: Next, he hops to Bangkok, Thailand, a hub for film.

beats.label: stop 5 Bangkok
beats.voice: In 2025, Thailand hosted 546 foreign film productions.

beats.label: stop 6 Rayong
beats.voice: Then, he rides to Rayong, Thailand, a hub for cars.

beats.label: stop 6 Rayong
beats.voice: Changan opened a plant here in 2025 for 10 billion baht.

beats.label: stop 7 Penang
beats.voice: Next, he flies to Penang, Malaysia, a hub for chips.

beats.label: stop 7 Penang
beats.voice: Intel's site here, opened in 1972, employs 15,000 people.

beats.label: stop 8 Morowali
beats.voice: Then, he flies to Morowali, Indonesia, a hub for nickel.

beats.label: stop 8 Morowali
beats.voice: Its industrial park had about 85,000 workers in 2024.

beats.label: stop 9 Manila
beats.voice: Finally, he lands in Manila, the Philippines, a hub for outsourced services.

beats.label: stop 9 Manila
beats.voice: The country's outsourcing industry employed 1.9 million people in 2025.

beats.label: summary
beats.voice: So that was Southeast Asia.

beats.label: summary
beats.voice: Next, part eight maps South Asia, the Gulf and Central Asia.

beats.label: cta
beats.voice: To climb in these cities, you need a good business foundation.

beats.label: cta
beats.voice: Go to Edlintics.com to learn technical business skills.

stops.fact: Singapore's asset management industry grew 10.1% in 2025 to record assets under management of S$6.7 trillion (MAS), and more than 2,000 single-family offices had MAS tax incentives at end-2025; OCBC (63 Chulia Street), its private bank Bank of Singapore (63 Market Street) and UOB (80 Raffles Place) have their head offices here. Sea Limited (1 Fusionopolis Place) says Garena connected on average with more than 100 million players daily throughout 2025; Ubisoft has had a studio here since 2008 (1 Fusionopolis Walk) and Virtuos has its head office here
stops.source: MAS, written parliamentary reply on single family offices, 5 Aug 2026: https://www.mas.gov.sg/news/parliamentary-replies/2026/written-reply-on-sfos ; Business Times, 29 Jul 2026 (MAS asset management survey, 28 Jul 2026) ; OCBC international network: https://www.ocbc.com/group/about-us/international-network ; UOB 4Q25 release: https://www.uobgroup.com/investor-relations/assets/pdfs/investor/financial/2025/news-release-4q-2025.pdf ; Sea Limited, fourth quarter and full year 2025 results, 3 Mar 2026 (cdn.sea.com results PDF) ; Sea contact page: https://www.sea.com/contact ; Ubisoft Singapore: https://www.ubisoft.com/en-us/studio/singapore.aspx ; Virtuos HQ: GamesBeat, 15 Mar 2018, and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Virtuos
stops.figureDate: End of 2025 (MAS, July and August 2026); Garena: 2025 (published 3 March 2026)

stops.fact: Samsung's phone plants in Bac Ninh and Thai Nguyen had made 2 billion phones by the end of June 2025, with about 90,000 Vietnamese workers (plants, not a head office)
stops.source: Vietnam Government News, Samsung produces 2 billionth mobile phone in Viet Nam: https://en.baochinhphu.vn/samsung-produces-2-billionth-mobile-phone-in-viet-nam-1112508271304324.htm

stops.fact: Ho Chi Minh City (the city as merged in July 2025) made about 23% of Vietnam's GDP in 2025: 23.11% in the national statistics office's figure (GRDP near 2.7 quadrillion dong, up 7.53%), 23.5% in the city's December estimate; Vinamilk (10 Tan Trao), Masan Group (23 Le Duan) and ACB (442 Nguyen Thi Minh Khai) have their head offices here
stops.source: Znews, 8 Jan 2026, citing the national statistics office: https://znews.vn/tphcm-gop-gan-14-tang-truong-ca-nuoc-post1617427.html ; VietnamPlus, 9 Dec 2025: https://en.vietnamplus.vn/hcm-city-projects-strong-8-growth-for-2025-post333949.vnp ; Vinamilk 2025 AGM minutes: https://static2.vietstock.vn/vietstock/2025/4/29/20250429_20250429___vnm___minutes___resolution_of_the_2025_agm.pdf ; Masan head office: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masan_Group ; ACB head office: https://acb.com.vn/en/about-us/inauguration-of-acb-headquarters-building-in-ho-chi-minh-city

stops.fact: Cambodia's garment, footwear and travel goods sector employs over 900,000 workers in more than 1,500 factories; its exports were US$15.5 billion in 2025 (a country figure; Phnom Penh is the capital)

Thailand hosted 546 foreign film productions in 2025, spending over 7.717 billion baht (Department of Tourism); Bangkok is among the most in-demand filming locations; GDH 559's head office is on Sukhumvit 31, Watthana, Bangkok
stops.source: The Nation, 14 Jan 2026: https://www.nationthailand.com/news/tourism/40061194 ; Government Public Relations Department, 21 Jul 2025: https://thailand.prd.go.th/en/content/category/detail/id/52/iid/407372 ; GDH 559 contact page: https://www.gdh559.com/contact

stops.fact: Changan Automobile began production at its first overseas plant, in Rayong, on 16 May 2025, an investment of about THB 10 billion with a capacity of 100,000 vehicles a year (a plant; the head office is in China); BYD (WHA Industrial Estate, Rayong) and Great Wall Motor (Pluak Daeng, Rayong) also have car plants in Rayong
stops.source: Gasgoo, 16 May 2025: https://autonews.gasgoo.com/articles/market-industry/changan-automobile-begins-production-at-rayong-plant-in-thailand-70037455 ; BYD plant: The Thaiger, BYD opens first EV plant in Thailand ; GWM Rayong plant: https://www.gwm-global.com/news/3401476.html

stops.fact: Intel's Penang site, opened in 1972, has a workforce of 15,000; Micron opened its second assembly and test site in Penang in 2023; Penang holds about 13% of global chip packaging (sites, not head offices)

The Indonesia Morowali Industrial Park (IMIP) had about 85,000 workers at the end of 2024; Indonesia produced nearly half of the world's nickel in 2022; Tsingshan owns a nickel smelter inside the park (a plant)
The Philippine IT and business process management industry employed 1.9 million people in 2025 and earned over USD 40 billion in export revenue (a country figure; Metro Manila is its main hub)

caption:
Career hub cities in Asia with Ledger, Part 7, goes to Southeast Asia with nine stops, and each stop shows one industry that city is a hub for, with a sourced fact

So you will meet Singapore for wealth management and video games, Bac Ninh for phones, Ho Chi Minh City for business and finance, Phnom Penh for garments, Bangkok for film, Rayong for cars, Penang for chips, Morowali for nickel, and Manila for outsourced services

Save the map for later, because Part 8 maps career hub cities across South Asia, the Gulf and Central Asia

not_verified: Singapore's S$6.7 trillion is all asset management (not only private wealth), from MAS's parliamentary reply and the Business Times report on the MAS survey; the survey page itself was not opened. DBS has no usable Commons logo, so the wealth stop shows OCBC, Bank of Singapore and UOB. Virtuos's head office rests on GamesBeat (2018) and Wikipedia (its own page blocked the fetcher). Ho Chi Minh City's share is for the city as merged in July 2025 (23.11% statistics office, 23.5% city estimate). Masan's logo file on Commons was uploaded on 26 Oct 2026 and checked by eye. Phnom Penh, Bangkok and Manila use country figures (Cambodia's garment sector, Thailand's foreign film shoots, the Philippine IT-BPM industry). Bac Ninh's 2 billion phones include Samsung's Thai Nguyen plants ('here and nearby'). Morowali's worker count is from Wikipedia's IMIP page. Sea's head-office address is from its contact page footer, and Garena's player figure from Sea's results release
